ja: 金曜までには終えられません。
en: I can't finish it by Friday.
alternatives: I can't get it done by Friday.
I'm unable to finish by Friday.
point: できないは can't、期限は by

ja: 納期がいつか、ご存じですか？
en: Do you know when it's due?
alternatives: Do you know when it's due by?
point: 間接疑問は when it's due の語順

ja: わかり次第、ご報告します。
en: I'll update you when I know.
alternatives: I'll update you once I know.
I'll let you know when I know.
point: when 節の中は未来でも現在形

ja: 売り上げは先月より好調です。
en: Sales are better than last month.
alternatives: Sales are up from last month.
Sales are stronger than last month.
point: 比べる相手は than で示す

ja: 報告書を書き終えました。

en: What worries me is the schedule.
alternatives: What I'm worried about is the schedule.
The schedule is what worries me.
point: What worries me is ~ の形で「〜なのは〜だ」
